description: Local cloud environment for coding agents to build, test, and debug Google Cloud applications through MCP discovery, SDK settings, resource inspection, queries, and diagnostics. Requires Docker engine, the native macOS/Linux LocalCloud CLI, and the LocalCloud Docker image. Run localcloud mcp over stdio. For Cursor, prefer lc mcp install --client cursor, or set the JSON command to the absolute path returned by command -v localcloud.

notes: Local workflows do not require a Google Cloud account or real Google Cloud credentials. Docker must be running; the CLI obtains the LocalCloud image when needed.

The LocalCloud CLI stdio bridge and standard SDK Storage/Pub/Sub/BigQuery workflows were validated. No public remote MCP endpoint is advertised; the setup-guide URL is documentation. GUI clients may need the absolute CLI path from command -v localcloud.
